review: Terrible performance.. steamvr is constantly giving the red watching to say the application is unresponsive.

Was auch immer es ist, es ist eigentlich ganz nett anzusehen. Allerdings zieht es dermaßen an der CPU, dass ich nicht nur Ruckler hatte, sondern zeitweise auch ganze Aussetzer. Da stimmt irgendwas nicht.

It was pretty enthralling being at the precipice of a rock in the midst of outer space. I wasn't encountering any issues breaking apart the small asteroid, but about 30 seconds to a minute into the experience it began to stutter between my VR console and the experience. Pretty unsettling. Also when there was a transition this same stuttering would occur. Looking forward to when this will be fixed.
This is the defacto demo for showing people VR for the first time.
OK, now that I changed some SteamVR settings, this runs beautifully.  I LOVE the concept and as a prologue of a future full game/experience this really shows off how awesome VR can be!

Expérience sensorielle de haute qualité
je la recommande vivement, d'autant plus qu'elle est offerte.
